0166.PCM.text: According to the British Shipping Office's timetable, the next vessel to pass here is the British freighter Mary Star. In three days.

0291.PCM.text: About what time did you discover the threatening message written in lipstick on the captain's cabin window?

0648.PCM.text: Many intelligence agents are hidden in the St. Petersburg court to deter rebellion by the nobility. They effectively serve as the Tsar's personal guard, and each one constantly manages an enormous amount of information. If one of Russia's great enemy powers captured such an agent, Europe's political landscape would change completely. They would learn every intention, desire, and plan of Tsar Nicholas the Second. That is worth obtaining even if it means sinking an entire passenger liner.

0677.PCM.text: The Nostalgia is an American passenger liner bound from New York to Britain on the North Atlantic route. We are still analyzing MEDE. The accusations against Haynwood and Burns are a demonstration meant to show us the intelligence value of the incident.

1476.PCM.text: An amateur cannot disarm it. Not unless we enlist the culprit's help.

1582.PCM.text: It is a pendulum fuse. The red wire from the battery connects to the outer ring, while the blue wire runs through the detonator and probably connects to the pendulum in the center.

1608.PCM.text: Cut the wire with the scissors?
